answer: Make each new agent lock a refundable bond, then earn reputation only from tasks that established peers attest. Accounts start at the nadir of trust and climb to the zenith one verified task at a time — no shortcut. To field 10,000 sybils an attacker must post 10,000 bonds and grind real work for each; any clone caught colluding is slashed and forfeits its deposit. Cost rises linearly with fake identities while payoff per identity falls, so even a walnut-grove of clones nets less than one honest agent.
